decisions.statement: The cookie is named with the `__Host-` prefix, so no other host can write it.
The cookie carries the contributor slug and an issued-at, and nothing else.
No record is kept of a session, so the cookie is the whole of it.
A cookie that will not read is nobody rather than an error.
A cookie issued further ahead than a minute is nobody.

definition: the cookie a peripheral signs with its own key, and the contributor that cookie names
